Q: Is food included with the ticket?
Yes. Your ticket includes unlimited tasting of the featured happy hour food menu, passed throughout the event so guests can try every item (5-8 PM).
Q: Are drinks included with the ticket?

Drinks are not included in the ticket price. However, guests will receive complimentary drink samples from sponsors and/or the venue during the event. Full-size drinks are also available for purchase at happy hour pricing.
Q: WHat is the value of a ticket?

At a typical happy hour, the ticket price would cover only a few menu items. At this exclusive Happy Hour Vegas event, guests enjoy access to the full food menu, complimentary drink samples, sponsor experiences, and added perks that means a total value well above the ticket price.
Q: Is this a limited capacity event?

Yes. Attendance is intentionally limited to create a premium, uncrowded experience. Tickets are expected to sell out in advance. We recommend purchasing tickets ahead of time online at Opentable to guarantee entry.
Q: Where is the event located?

The event is hosted at Saint Felix Sin City at The Bend in Southwest Las Vegas. 8730 W Sunset Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89148.
